description: run-prepare.js emits tether-setup: and tether-onboard: progress markers to stderr; verify-smoke.py matches those exact marker strings (SETUP_MARKERS) and regexes (ONBOARD_RECORDS_RE, ONBOARD_COVERAGE_RE) to validate a run. Changing a marker string in the hook must update the matching pattern in the verifier, or validation silently passes or misreports.
